capabilities: Delete all checked checklist items in a note
Run the deletion from the command palette
Trigger the deletion from the file menu
extras: The README only describes the feature and its two entry points (command and file menu); it notes the plugin works on both desktop and mobile, and the manifest states it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bulk-remove completed checklist items from a note.
summary: Adds a command and file-menu action that deletes all checked checklist items from the current note at once.
